ui.title: MSA Architecture Diagram
ui.subtitle: K3s Cluster Microservices Architecture Status and Improvement Plan
ui.infra_desc: Spring Cloud Gateway, Cluster Infrastructure, Monitoring/Log/Tracing/Backup, Mail Server, and CI/CD are shared between leedohyun.com and posselect.com. To avoid repeating these in each domain's diagram, they are separated into this tab.
ui.roadmap_title: Long-term Roadmap — Assuming Cloud Transition and Large-scale Expansion (Confirmed 2026-08-06)

current.title: Current K3s Cluster Architecture (Deployed Status)

gateway.name: Spring Cloud Gateway
domains: Actual entry point for all *.leedohyun.com + all *.posselect.com (Shared single gateway)

personal_line.name: MinIO
personal_line.desc: S3-compatible object storage. Shared instance for personal and shopping mall use.

shop_line.name: store.front
shop_line.desc: Shopping mall main landing page (Next.js). Product info and banner API integration completed for main page sections.

shop_line.name: customer.front / auth.api
shop_line.desc: Login/Signup/Profile editing features. Backend integration completed for terms of service and privacy policy.

shop_line.name: product.front / product-api
shop_line.desc: Product list and cart. Product info API caching applied.

shop_line.name: Keycloak
shop_line.desc: SSO/OAuth2·OIDC authentication server dedicated for the shopping mall.

shop_line.name: Grafana (Monitoring)
shop_line.desc: Shopping mall dedicated monitoring. Metric scraping for gateway and APIs.

shop_line.name: imgproxy CDN
shop_line.desc: Dynamic image resizing server. Provides signed URLs based on MinIO.

shop_line.name: posselect-ui
shop_line.desc: Design system reference page. Storybook environment improved with responsive/multi-language components and accessibility checks.

shop_line.name: posselect-shell
shop_line.desc: Runtime shell for common header/footer and category drawer (static serving).

mail.name: Self-hosted Mail (docker-mailserver)
mail.desc: Sends auth emails/order notifications, DKIM signed for both domains

infrastructure.name: kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager)
infrastructure.desc: Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager monitoring stack. Email alert integration.

infrastructure.name: Loki / Promtail
infrastructure.desc: Cluster-wide container log collection for all namespaces.

infrastructure.name: Velero (Backup Automation)
infrastructure.desc: Daily automated backup of PVC data based on MinIO.

cicd.name: self-hosted runner CD (Auto deployment)
cicd.scope: gateway / auth.api / store.front / customer.front / admin.front / order.api / product.api

issues: Security hardening not applied (RBAC granularity, NetworkPolicy, Istio mTLS — planned only)
Distributed tracing only measures 4 Java backends (Next.js frontends not measured), no Kiali/Service Mesh observability yet
Single point of failure (Single node cluster, no redundancy)
Alertmanager only integrated with Email, additional channels like Slack not integrated
Self-hosted mail server uses home dynamic IP+no PTR, potential spam folder delivery (Structural limit)
customer.front needs social login (Kakao/Naver/Google) and phone verification backend integration
Velero needs periodic (e.g. 3 months) recovery validation routine

domain_split.title: Domain Restructuring: Separation of leedohyun.com (Personal) / posselect.com (Shop) (2026-08-02)
domain_split.summary: Completed domain separation between leedohyun.com (Personal) and posselect.com (Shopping mall). K3s infrastructure is shared, but Auth/Routing/DNS layers are operated independently.
migrated_items: Route53: New posselect.com hosted zone and record separation
TLS: Dedicated wildcard certificate separation for posselect.com
Ingress: Separation of routing entry points by domain
Gateway: Domain independence secured through externalized security configs
Keycloak: Separation of shopping mall dedicated authentication server
Mail: Setup of dedicated mail server account for the shopping mall
domain_split.backward_compat: Legacy leedohyun.com based hosts redirect to posselect.com with 302 to maintain compatibility.

improved.name: Spring Cloud Gateway Single Entry Point
Prometheus / Grafana
domains: Production service and DB metric integration completed

improved.name: Alertmanager External Alerts
domains: Email alert channel integration completed. Additional channels planned later

improved.name: Velero (Backup Automation)
domains: All namespaces daily backup configuration completed

improved.name: Kiali
domains: Service Mesh observability — Pending due to Istio dependency

roadmap.desc: The current K3s single node system is a transitional infrastructure. We plan a large-scale expansion to a managed cloud infrastructure along with the introduction of VOD and live streaming as the shopping mall service traffic grows.

items.name: Infrastructure Independence of URL Path Design
domains: MinIO bucket and path independent design considering S3 migration

items.name: Establish CDN Bucket Naming Convention
domains: Bucket configuration principle based on content type (shop/static, shop/image)

items.name: VOD (Video on Demand)
domains: Plan to introduce managed VOD service for CPU-intensive transcoding

items.name: Real-time Live Streaming
domains: Expansion of live streaming features based on managed services like AWS IVS

items.name: Subdomain → Single CDN Domain Integration
domains: Consider integration to a single CDN domain + Path-based structure in the future
